guidelines.detail: same as LRN-018 (The description says an employee submits a request to start the process, but the reference task for that action is missing while the generated model uses a start event in its place. This supports modeling the initiating action as a task; the same guidance is already captured by LRN-018.)

same as LRN-013 (The generated label in P2 uses “request,” while the description and reference identify the registered object as the requirement. The other label pairs are broadly faithful paraphrases. LRN-013 already covers preserving stated activity details in task labels.)

refines FID-01 (The description explicitly places registration before receipt, and the reference includes a registration task that is absent from the generated model. This makes the general requirement to model every stated activity more specific.)
same as LRN-032 (Several generated labels omit the explicitly stated performer, while the description identifies who performs those actions. The proposed guideline matches learned guideline LRN-032.)

same as LRN-081 (The description establishes that registration precedes the supervisor receiving the request, and the record identifies the registration activity as missing. This supports the guideline, which is already captured by learned guideline LRN-081.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says a participant performs a concrete action that initiates the process, rather than merely identifying an event that triggers it: Model the initiating action as a task after the start event and before the subsequent activity; do not represent the action only as a start event.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that a participant performs a concrete action that initiates the process

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description explicitly states an activity’s action, object, recipient, or multiple coordinated actions: Preserve those stated details in the BPMN task label rather than omitting or substituting them.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states an activity’s action and object

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that an item is registered before another participant receives or acts on it: Model the registration as a distinct activity before the subsequent receipt or action.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that an item is registered before another participant receives or acts on it

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description explicitly identifies who performs an activity: Use a concise BPMN activity label that preserves the stated performer as well as the action, when needed to distinguish whose action it is.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description explicitly identifies who performs an activity

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states an activity or outcome whose surrounding context is already clear from the process flow: Use a concise BPMN label that preserves the activity or outcome, without adding explanatory context that does not distinguish it from other elements.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says a participant can or may perform a follow-up action, rather than stating that the action necessarily occurs
